We must first make clear what power is and what are its accidents.
Power is that by which we effect movement or change in another.
Various meanings assigned to 'power' by Aristotle.
It may be created or uncreated.
Created power may be corporal or spiritual.
2. Power may be passive, responding to active power.
3. Power is what enables us to do things well; i. e. according to our wishes.
The inalienable power of doing right is called by Anselm Free will.
4. Power may be an acquired accident, e. g. medicinal skill.
It may be supernatural, as in the ministration of the sacraments, or civil, inflicting penalties on rebels to the Church,
Besides all these meanings 'power' denotes an order of angels,

Dignity: This is self evident.
Antiquity: It is believed that Adam and Cain had a sort of priesthood.
In God however the kingly power has priority.
